optimization_recommendations.action_base: Switch lunch to Bin Sushi (Option C) to save 39 CNY

optimization_recommendations.action_base: Switch lunch to baker&spice (Option D) to save 62 CNY
optimization_recommendations.details_base: baker&spice at Wangfu Zhonghuan B1 (69 CNY) is lightest and cheapest lunch. Saves 62 CNY vs THE WOODS. Shopping budget increases to 1,792 CNY. Best for quick light lunch before shopping.

optimization_recommendations.action_base: Skip Slow Boat Brewery to preserve full shopping budget

optimization_recommendations.action_base: Prioritize APM and Wangfujing Department Store over Jinbao Place luxury mall
